extraction_warnings: The paper reports cohort-level aggregate data (n=41 healthy controls, n=56 pre-hypertensive, n=99 hypertensive) rather than individual sample identifiers or per-sample rows. Individual subject_id and sample_id values are not available in the paper.

Sex distribution by group is not explicitly reported. The paper notes 'the gender ratio is discrepant among groups' but does not provide specific breakdowns. The sample above reflects 'Male' as the sex for GF mice recipients in the FMT experiment.
Age is not reported for individual participants; only that they are employees from the Kailuan Group Corporation cohort (adult population).

The control group classification represents healthy controls meeting the criteria: SBP ≤125 mmHg or DBP ≤80 mmHg, no diabetes or hypercholesterolemia history, and no antibiotic/probiotic use in 8 weeks prior.
Country is inferred as China based on 'large modern city in northern China' (Tangshan) and explicit statement 'cohort of 196 Chinese individuals'; ancestry not reported in paper.
Antibiotics_current_use is set to 'No' as a criterion: 'Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks.'

The schema requests sample-level data, but the paper provides only study-level and subgroup-level summaries. No individual sample identifiers, per-sample biomarker values, or longitudinal sample tracking are provided in the text.
Batch 1 returned granularity='subgroup_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 1 subgroups ['Healthy controls', 'Pre-hypertension', 'Hypertension', 'HTN mice (after FMT)', 'Control mice (after FMT)'] differ from batch 0 []; kept batch 0.
The schema fields are largely cancer/oncology-focused (RECIST, TNM staging, tumor size, ECOG), but this paper is a microbiome/metabolomics study of hypertension. Few schema fields are applicable.

FMT study design involved 2 HTN donors and 1 control donor transplanted into separate groups of germ-free mice (5 control mice, 10 HTN mice). Donor-level identifiers and detailed mapping are not provided in the paper.

Disease details for human participants: 41 healthy controls, 56 pre-hypertensive, 99 hypertensive. Metabolomics subset: 30 controls, 31 pre-hypertensive, 63 hypertensive (n=124). FMT validation cohort: 6 subjects from independent diabetes study (3 HTN, 3 normotensive controls).
Blood pressure (SBP, DBP, MBP) and heart rate measured in mice post-FMT; significantly elevated in HTN mice (P<0.05 for BP measures, P=0.11 for HR).
No adverse events, mortality, progression-free survival, or other clinical trial endpoints reported for human subjects.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.
The schema field 'host_species' expects enum type but paper involves both human and mouse studies; returned as list to capture both.
Tumor_size_residual_measurement is not applicable to this microbiota/hypertension study; marked as not_reported.
DNA extraction kit value 'TIANGEN' appears verbatim in paper and matches allowed enum value exactly.
Sequencing platform for shotgun metagenomic sequencing is described as 'Illumina platform' in main text; mapped to 'Illumina HiSeq' based on Methods section detail.
